name: Shortest interval above 50 containing distinct multiples of 1, ..., 50
description: construct() -> integers b_1, ..., b_50 with 50 < b_i <= 5000, i | b_i and all b_i distinct. The score is max(b) - 50 + 1, the least k with every b_i in the open interval (50, 50 + k). Minimize; the optimum is 77. For n = 50 the optimum is 77, so the task recovers an optimal matching.

sources.locator: Paul Erdős and Carl Pomerance, Matching the natural numbers up to n with distinct multiples in another interval (1980). Crossref record inspected; Erdős Problem #710 page inspected (Erdős and Pomerance: (2/sqrt e + o(1)) n (log n/log log n)^(1/2) <= f(n) <= (1.7398...+o(1)) n (log n)^(1/2); Erdős offered 2000 rupees for an asymptotic formula). OEIS A390246 inspected (b-file by Kesarwani): f(50) = 77. For n = 50 the optimum is 77, so the task recovers an optimal matching.
